opening.argument: The speaker ties substantial daily earnings directly to joining an earning system and team. He tells viewers they can earn "10-30,000 in one day" and directs them to join a free meeting so they can earn at least 5,000 to 7,000. He then explicitly invites them to become part of the system and team, saying, "Let's be a part of this beautiful system." Reported system earnings are presented as promotional support for participation, including a claim that the system earned 90,000 Pakistani rupees. The opportunity is therefore recruitment-oriented rather than merely informational.
